— Asha

Thanks for the note, Asha — sorry for the surprise. I pulled the invoice number and looping in Monica from Billing to confirm details and next steps.

Quick context from my side: promo credits are issued at signup but can be exhausted depending on usage and model selection. Separately, accounts can enable auto-top-up which charges the card on file when credits run out. Two asks so we can resolve quickly:

- Monica: can you check whether the promo credits were exhausted and whether auto-top-up triggered the charge on 2027-04-18?
- Asha: please confirm the SkyForge billing account id (if different from this email) and whether you have a VAT ID to share. If you'd like a refund to the card vs. a platform credit, please state preference.

Best,

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Unexpected charge on trial account - invoice INV-20270418

Hi Asha, Ben — I checked the ledger and here's what happened:

- Promo credits: SkyForge AI was issued a €5,000 promotional credit at signup on 2027-04-11.
- Usage: On 2027-04-17 evening, there was a spike (long-generation batch jobs) that consumed the remaining promo balance and crossed your configured soft-limit.
- Auto-top-up: The account had the "auto-purchase" toggle enabled. Once credits were exhausted, the system purchased a predefined token pack which generated invoice INV-20270418 for €1,237.50.
- VAT: Because SkyForge did not provide a valid EU VAT number in the billing profile, our system applied the default German VAT rate of 19% on the taxable base. If you provide a valid EU VAT ID and it matches your company record, we can zero-rate VAT on the invoice retroactively where applicable.

Options to resolve:
1) We can reverse the auto-purchase and issue a refund to the card on file (finance will need your explicit confirmation).
2) Issue a platform credit of €1,237.50 and extend your promo window by 14 days while we stabilize usage limits.
3) If you provide a VAT ID that qualifies, we can reissue the invoice without VAT and refund the VAT portion (or apply as credit).

Attached: invoice_20270418.pdf and a short Refund Request form (refund_request_form.pdf) if you want a card refund.

If you tell me which option you prefer and supply the VAT ID (if relevant), I will initiate the work.

— Monica
Monica Patel
Billing Operations — Redwood Inference

- We validated VAT ID DE314159265 against VIES; the VAT ID is valid for SkyForge AI GmbH.
- Refund: €1,237.50 refunded to the card on file (transaction RR-20270419-442). Refund typically posts within 3–5 business days depending on the bank.
- Credit note: credit_note_20270419.pdf attached and invoice INV-20270418 is marked as corrected (VAT reversed where applicable).
- Promo extension: CS applied +14 days and a hard consumption cap of €300/day until 2027-05-03 to avoid accidental overage.

Asha: let us know if you prefer a platform credit instead of a card refund (we can still convert). Otherwise consider this closed on our side; reach out if the refund does not appear in 5 business days.

Thanks — Rishi
